lines.en: label makotodorm5:
I knock on Makoto's door and wait for her to-
: Just a minute!
Well, I didn't have to wait long.
I lean against the wall and wait for her to finish doing whatever it is she's doing, wondering if she'll actually let me in or not.
Given that this is Makoto we're talking about and I am a teacher, I'm sure she will.
But I'm also sure there will be some sort of questioning as well since this is very likely against some sort of rule.
scene platonicredux1
: Sorry, I was just-
: Wait...Sensei? What are you doing here? Do you need me for something? Is everything okay? Do you-
: Everything is fine. I was just looking to kill some time before going home for the night.
: Kill some time? And...how exactly do you plan to do that?
: Maybe...we could hang out in your room or something?
scene platonicredux2
: M-My room?! But...but why would you want to go in there?!
: It makes more sense than hanging out in the hallway, doesn't it?
: Unless you don't think we're close enough or something.
scene platonicredux3
: I mean...do you really think we're that close?
: I suppose I have probably spent more time with you than anyone else, save Ami...
: But...I don’t know. This just seems like...a lot, all of a sudden.
: Are you...uncomfortable being alone with me, Makoto? Because you seem to be making a pretty big deal out of this.
scene platonicredux2
: Because it is a big deal, Sensei!
: And the room is a mess anyway so-
: Makoto.
scene platonicredux4
: W-What?...
: If my class representative doesn't trust me enough to let me into her room, I might have to choose another one.
scene platonicredux2
: You wouldn’t dare! Also, isn't that blackmail?!
: Is there a rule in the student handbook against blackmail?
: I don't...think so? But I’m pretty sure there are several laws against it!
: Then I guess I’ll just have to start looking for-
scene platonicredux3
: Um, wait!
: I...suppose I might be making a bigger deal of having a boy in my room than I should...
: I mean, how much different could having you around be compared to someone like Miku?
: Sure, you're twice my size and...twice my age and...in a position of power and-
: Yeah, I get it. Now, are you going to open the door or what?
: Y-Yes...
: As long as you’re okay with me...
scene platonicredux5
: Uhh...okay with it! Not okay with me! Saying me made it sound like I was insinuating something inappropriate, which I absolutely was not!
: I understand that it's totally normal for a teacher to visit a student's dorm room at night and I am going to stop yelling right now because this probably sounds very suspicious!
: Good call, Makoto...
scene black
Of course, I never intended to actually blackmail Makoto.
I haven't been around for long, but even the short amount of time I have spent here has been way more than sufficient in revealing exactly how much she does for me.
In fact, I don't think I've had to sign a single paper yet.
Signing papers is probably a thing teachers have to do, right?
I honestly don't know- which is further proof of exactly how useful Makoto has been.
I just understand the type of girl she is and I understand how to get what I want out of people like her.
She's lucky I don't want much.
scene makotofirstdorm1
: So...here we are...
: Just a boy and a girl alone in a [high_school] dorm room...
: Just...two people in a completely platonic relationship gathering in a private location in the middle of the night...
: Plain old normal stuff. No rules being broken here.
: It's strange that you’re still embarrassed by something like this even after hanging out with me in a building that sells fake vaginas.
scene makotofirstdorm2
: This is entirely different! You came to the porn shop to buy things, not to see me!
: Well...at least the first time!
: Today, you're actually here for me, though! And I'm just...trying to wrap my head around what that could possibly mean.
: Why does it have to mean anything? You should know better than anyone that there's no scientific reason compelling people to come together.
scene makotofirstdorm3
: Well, actually...there are plenty of scientific reasons that would explain a thing like that. And several of which would likely be relevant here.
: But...you would clearly know that as well, so...chances are you only said there weren't reasons because you'd prefer I ignore their existence for the time being...
: Perhaps this is some sort of...riddle, maybe?...But what could you possibly-
: Makoto, I just wanted to see you. It's that simple.
scene makotofirstdorm4
: It is?...
: Of course.
: Now, if you wanted to spend our time together watching porn, that would be totally acceptable as well.
: I understand better than anyone how hard it is being away from that for too long. You don't have to hide your pain from me.
scene makotofirstdorm2
: There is no pain! I'm perfectly comfortable being away from pornography and am in no way dependent on it!
: That just sounded like a really complicated way to say you're better than me.
: Do you truly spend that much time rotting away your brain with that stuff?
: What if you become addicted and started neglecting your responsibilities as a teacher? That sort of thing can happen, you know.
I'm pretty sure it already has and I have done virtually no teaching whatsoever.
: If that happens I'd...
: Well, it would probably be up to me to get you back to normal and...
scene makotofirstdorm3
: Actually...that does sound like it might be fun now that I think about it...
: Just you and me...studying and...teaching each other all sorts of...
scene makotofirstdorm5
: Um...before I start getting excited...do you think it might be okay for me to maybe...help you teach the class one day?
Was...Makoto about to get turned on from a fantasy of us studying?...
: Just...as training, of course. You know, since I plan on becoming a teacher one day and whatnot.
: You can teach the class every day if you want. That will give me more time to sleep.
: I'm not sure if I can let you take over as counselor, though. That seems like more of a me thing.
It doesn't, really. I just don't want to surrender the opportunity to be alone with a variety of attractive teenage girls.
scene makotofirstdorm6
: Oh, umm...funny you should bring that up...because there’s something I’ve been wondering lately.
: That time we were alone in there and you...you know...massaged me...
: That was, like...just a me thing, right?...
: Like...there's no way you're just calling people in there to relieve their stress through...umm...physical treatment, are you?
: Would there be a problem if I was?
: There would be a multitude of problems if you were.
: But...I'd be able to overlook it if it was just a thing you did for me since...the two of us are close and everything.
: In fact, I...I probably wouldn't have even minded if-
scene makotofirstdorm6r
: A-Actually! I don't even know what I was about to say there.
: Please forgive me for my mind being all over the place, Sensei. It's been a long day and...I tend to ramble when I get exhausted.
: Sounds to me like someone could use another massage.
scene makotofirstdorm2
: You mean...right now?! In my bedroom?! Where the...bed is?!
: That is typically where you keep the bed, yes.
: I...I don't really know if...that's the best place for...
scene makotofirstdorm6r2
: Just...forget I even asked about the whole massage thing! This is quickly approaching non-platonic levels in my head and that...that would not be good at all.
I disagree wholeheartedly, but will keep my comments to myself for now so as to not risk scaring her away.
: I’ve just been really curious about why everyone seems to be in higher spirits lately and...figured your new methods might have something do with it.
: Assuming the...massages are part of your new teaching strategy. Which I am very much hoping they are not for everyone except me
: You're probably just only looking at specific girls or something.
: I'm sure Ayane has been in high spirits lately because I've been giving her more attention than normal, but I can't imagine someone like Yumi or Maya seeming any different at all.
scene makotofirstdorm7
: But...why only give Ayane more attention than normal? As everyone's teacher, shouldn't you be distributing your time among...well, everyone?
: Maybe? That's not really something I think about.
: It...probably should be.
: And it probably is. It's just a lot easier to please someone like Ayane than it is to please someone like Yumi, I guess.
: Pleasing Ayane doesn't sound particularly difficult given her...uhh...
: Innate desire to have my children?
scene makotofirstdorm7r
: Can you word it in a slightly less disgusting way next time?
: It is annoying enough having to listen to the overtly-sexual nonsense coming from her mouth and I don't want to have to hear it coming from yours as well.
: Is that jealousy I hear, Makoto?
scene makotofirstdorm8
: Jealous? Me? Don't be absurd.
: What would I have to be jealous about, Sensei?
: Ayane's nonsense is just that, isn't it? Nonsense?
: Don't tell me you've actually been up to anything inappropriate with her.
: Can you define inappropriate, please?
: Do I really have to?
: You know what? I'm just going to go with no. That seems like the safe answer.
scene makotofirstdorm2
: I take exception to how uncertain you sound right now.
: The two of you aren’t involved in some sort of...illicit relationship, are you?
: Can you define illicit, please?
scene makotofirstdorm8r
: That fucking bitch...
: Makoto?
scene makotofirstdorm5
: Yes, Sensei?
: You doing okay?
: Of course, Sensei.
: Good...Well, just to reiterate, nothing weird is going on in my office and I'll do my best to contain my unearthly desire to massage everyone to you and you only.
: I greatly appreciate that. Thank you.
: Any time. So, feel free to stop by my office whenever you like.
: Absolutely. I’ve been meaning to drop by recently anyway.
: Oh yeah? Why's that?
scene makotofirstdorm6
: I just...realized it might be time for me to start thinking about college and wanted to explore some options with you.
Why is she already thinking about that as a freshman? Shouldn't she be focusing more on just...making it through high school first?
: You sure you don’t want a massage instead?
if day26 == True:
: I’m sure. And I already told you that we probably shouldn’t be doing that stuff in[school], didn’t I?
: Save your massages for when we're somewhere else.
: Just not in school and not in your bedroom...
: Wait. Does that mean-
: I would sooner die than allow you to massage me at my work.
Damn it.
else:
: Very sure. School is clearly not the place for things like that.
scene makotofirstdorm7
: As for everywhere else, though...I think it might be okay under the right circumstances...
: Those circumstances being?...
scene makotofirstdorm8
: I'm not quite sure as I've yet to make a list.
: It would have to be on rare occasions only, though. I’m afraid I’d become too dependent on your skills if you were to just start rubbing my shoulders each time we met.
: I mean... there are other areas I can-
: Don't you dare finish that sentence.
: What's wrong? I was obviously just referring to your back and your neck and...an assortment of other safe-for-work areas.
: Let’s just stick to the shoulders for now, okay?
scene black
Makoto and I hang out for a little while longer and, unfortunately, the topic of massages fizzles out.
I was pretty confident I'd at least get to touch her tonight on account of our apparent mutual interest in one another, but-
Perhaps she's not interested in the same way I am just yet?
She'll get there soon enough, though.
There's only so much willpower a person can have- and when you're surrounded by sex on a day-to-day basis, I can't imagine that not eating away at you.
Being alone with the person you admire will only exacerbate that craving.
She can block out her curiosities as much as she wants, but the walls keeping them contained will only hold for so long- and I will be the one to hold her after that.
Eventually, the two of us decide it's best for me to leave as Miku informs Makoto that she's on the way home.
And just like that, without even a moment of contact, I'm headed back to my house...
